description: This file defines the TraceMiddleware class in the AWS PHP SDK. The class is responsible for tracing and logging state changes between AWS middleware components, including request/response details, command execution, and error handling. It scrubs sensitive information from logs and provides detailed debug output for HTTP requests and AWS commands.

classes.name: TraceMiddleware
classes.description: A class that intercepts and logs the state of AWS SDK command executions, including request, response, and errors, with support for scrubbing sensitive information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TraceMiddleware with configuration options and an optional AWS Service object for shape-based redaction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Sets up the middleware step, intercepting commands and responses to log and trace middleware state changes.

methods.name: stepInput
methods.description: Logs input parameters for a command, noting any changes from previous input.

methods.name: stepOutput
methods.description: Logs the output or error information after a command is executed, including timing.

methods.name: compareStep
methods.description: Compares previous and current step data, summarizing differences in the trace log.

methods.name: commandArray
methods.description: Converts a command object into an array with its properties for logging.

methods.name: requestArray
methods.description: Converts an HTTP request into an array format, redacting headers and body as needed.

methods.name: responseArray
methods.description: Converts an HTTP response into an array format for logging purposes.

methods.name: resultArray
methods.description: Serializes a result object for logging.

methods.name: exceptionArray
methods.description: Serializes an exception or error, including special data for AwsException types.

methods.name: compareArray
methods.description: Recursively compares two arrays and records differences for logging.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts a scalar, exception, or array value into a string representation for logging.

methods.name: streamStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a stream, handling large streams appropriately.

methods.name: createHttpDebug
methods.description: Adds debug resource to HTTP commands if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: flushHttpDebug
methods.description: Reads and outputs HTTP debug information, then cleans up the debug resource.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs log messages, optionally scrubbing sensitive data using regex patterns.

methods.name: redactHeaders
methods.description: Redacts sensitive headers in HTTP messages.

methods.name: getRedactedArray
methods.description: Redacts sensitive command parameters based on AWS shape metadata.
